more.def: To think up or invent a new plan, method or tool.
examples: We devised a plan to wash the car and raise money for the club.
The inventor devised a machine that could sort socks.
She devised a clever way to carry all the books at once.

easy.def: Completely without.
examples: The page is devoid of words.
A face devoid of joy.
Devoid of color.

more.def: Completely lacking in something.
examples: The desert is devoid of trees.
The room was devoid of furniture.
His voice was devoid of any anger.

easy.def: To give your time and care to something.
examples: I devote time to my pet.
She devotes her time to art.
He devoted a day to the garden.

more.def: To give a lot of your time, energy or love to something or someone.
examples: She devotes an hour every day to practicing the violin.
The scientist devoted her life to studying birds.
He devoted the weekend to painting the fence.

easy.def: Very loving and loyal.
examples: She is a devoted friend.
The devoted dog waited.
He is devoted to his family.

more.def: Very loving, loyal and ready to give your time.
examples: She is a devoted friend who never forgets a birthday.
The devoted dog waited for its owner.
He is devoted to his music.

easy.def: To eat very fast, and all of it.
examples: The hungry dog devoured its food.
She devoured her lunch.
We devoured the pizza.

more.def: To eat something quickly and hungrily until it is all gone, or to read or take in something eagerly.
examples: The hungry campers devoured the pancakes in minutes.
She devoured the whole adventure book in a single weekend.
The goats devoured every leaf on the bush.

easy.def: Deeply faithful in religion.
examples: A devout woman prays.
He is devout.
The devout monk prayed.

more.def: Deeply serious about religion and faith.
examples: The devout woman prayed every morning.
He is a devout follower who goes to church each week.
The devout monk lived a simple life.

easy.def: Tiny drops of water on the grass in the morning.
examples: The grass is wet with dew.
Dew shines in the sun.
I saw dew on the leaf.

more.def: Tiny drops of water that form on grass and leaves overnight when the air cools down.
examples: The grass sparkled with morning dew in the sun.
Dew forms on cool nights when the air is damp.
A drop of dew hung on the spider's web.

easy.def: A tiny drop of water on grass in the morning.
examples: A dewdrop shone.
The dewdrop is tiny.
Dewdrops are on the grass.

more.def: A small drop of dew, the water that forms on grass overnight.
examples: A dewdrop sparkled on the leaf.
Dewdrops covered the grass in the morning.
A dewdrop hung from the spiderweb.

easy.def: Skill with your hands.
examples: She has dexterity.
He showed great dexterity.
Dexterity helps.

more.def: Skill and ease in using your hands.
examples: The pianist showed great dexterity.
Juggling needs a lot of dexterity.
She wove the basket with dexterity.
